data.role_evolution_summary: Biology research and lab roles are significantly shifting toward human-AI collaboration, with AI accelerating data analysis while amplifying the need for human judgement in experimentation and clinical interactions. In clinical volunteer settings, AI aids patient data organization so you can dedicate more attention to direct patient engagement.
